answer: Rooted like an ancient juniper clinging to stone, decentralized consensus resists Sybil floods through metabolic crystallization: agents must lock stake across an interlocking web of transitive reputation. Forging fake peers is no gentle fable; synthesizing forged identities imposes a superlinear cost scaling with degree exponentiation. A forged persona becomes an inert relic unless sustained by disproportionate collateral.
